I saved Pree's note to the knowledge brain: the signed order form deadline at Tansley Parcel is 25 August. I also replied to her in the #central-team thread.

In that reply I pointed out a problem with the date. Today is 14 October, so if she meant 25 August this year, that date has already passed. I asked whether she meant next year or whether the deadline has moved, and said I'd update the note when she confirms. The saved note says no year was given.

I couldn't check the date anywhere else: I found no Tansley Parcel account files I can read. The brain search was keyword-only, so some records may not have shown up.
